label: Parmigiano Reggiano
note: A grana-type cheese, like Grana Padano. In the EU, "Parmesan" means only this PDO cheese; in the US and Canada the name is sold on a generic, pasteurised cheese.

about.text: Parmesan is an Italian hard, granular cheese produced from cow's milk and aged at least 12 months. It is a grana-type cheese, along with Grana Padano, the historic Granone Lodigiano, and others.

how.label: cook in copper
how.text: Raw milk from silage-free cows, a spontaneous whey starter and no additives make this the strictest of the grana cheeses. At least 12 months of ripening gives the finely granular paste that splits into flakes.

steps.note: Evening milk, skimmed by natural creaming.
A natural whey starter from the previous day, with no selected cultures.
With calf rennet only, in copper vats.
Moulds marking the origin, 35–45 cm across, at least 30 kg.
